title: Designing Around Stigma: Human-Centered LLMs for Menstrual Health

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of chatbot interaction logs and workshop discussions to evaluate how well the LLM understands and aligns with local cultural myths, religious modesty norms (purdah), and traditional explanatory models of health (e.g., 'taseer' or hot/cold foods), compared to the culturally misaligned responses of baseline Western-centric models.

Analysis of user-chatbot conversation logs to evaluate the system's ability to correctly process, understand, and consistently respond in Roman Urdu and translingual text (mixed Urdu and English) without abruptly shifting languages.
